audit_scope: Read-only inspection and extraction of committed text reports, CSVs and compact JSON. No model, training, generated-program execution, benchmark, test suite, or runtime verification was run.
provenance_policy: Git object identities preserve exact upstream source identity without publishing numeric randomization values embedded in legacy paths. Use git cat-file -p GIT_BLOB in the pinned upstream checkout. Historical runs are not relabeled as prospective runs.

metric_notes.pass_at_k: Proportion, not percentage. Probability of at least one correct answer under a total draw budget k.
metric_notes.implementation_coverage_at_k: Expected distinct correct AST fingerprint classes under a total draw budget k; incorrect draws remain in the population.
metric_notes.correct_matched_coverage_at_4: Expected distinct AST classes in four correct draws, conditional on sufficient correct samples; denominator differs by method.
metric_notes.uncertainty: Reported intervals bootstrap evaluation tasks within one historical training trajectory. They do not measure independent training-run variability.
metric_notes.semantic_scope: AST classes are implementation proxies, not independently annotated algorithms.

main_mbpp_trajectory_n16.pass_at_16_audit_limit: Read from manuscript design table; this audit did not recompute these three values from raw task outcomes.

ssd_mbpp_trajectory_n16.comparison_limit: Separate initial resampling and continuation. Descriptive cross-run values are not a newly computed paired SPECTRUM-versus-SSD test. SSD uses an adapted synthesis decoding recipe.

frozen_apps_transfer_n16.protocol: APPS Intro native adapted verifier; 200 tasks, frozen MBPP-trained checkpoints, no target training

frozen_humaneval_transfer_n16.protocol: HumanEval+ historical transfer; 164 tasks; retain the original evaluator provenance, not a new run

cross_model_baseline_matrix.completion_basis: Committed status report and 20 aggregate table rows; raw per-task artifacts were not re-executed or independently audited here.
cross_model_baseline_matrix.does_not_establish: Trained SPECTRUM performance across four models and five benchmarks.

pilot.limit: Post-hoc first-fence extraction sensitivity analysis; a different small-task single-round study, not final-round or independent confirmation data.

natural_gate_0.existing_material: Task-level equal-correct-count AST contrasts in frozen HumanEval+/APPS results.
missing: Audited natural-task program sets linking initial, intervention-generator and post-SFT outcomes.
Blind semantic strategy labels or an explicit AST-only scope.
Prespecified natural-case selection, shared denominators, and a documented consequence tied to the observed failure.

prospective_final_study.limit: Runnable code and a finite execution plan are not completed results.
